# Finished Goods (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Finished Goods` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 9 actions on 4 resources, 6 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-finishedgoodslist) | `GET /finishedGoodsList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}&SaleID={SaleID}` |
| [GET](#get-finishedgoods) | `GET /finishedGoods?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-finishedgoods) | `POST /finishedGoods` |
| [PUT](#put-finishedgoods) | `PUT /finishedGoods` |
| [DELETE](#delete-finishedgoods) | `DELETE /finishedGoods?ID={ID}&Void={Void}` |
| [GET](#get-finishedgoods-order) | `GET /finishedGoods/order?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-finishedgoods-order) | `POST /finishedGoods/order` |
| [GET](#get-finishedgoods-pick) | `GET /finishedGoods/pick?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-finishedgoods-pick) | `POST /finishedGoods/pick` |

<a id="get-finishedgoodslist"></a>
### GET /finishedGoodsList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}&SaleID={SaleID}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100. (Default: 100)
- `Status` (optional): Only return Finished Goods with specified status (Default: null)
- `Search` (optional): Only return Finished Goods with search value contained in one of these fields: AssemblyNumber, Location, Status, Name, ProductCode, BatchSN, Notes (Default: null)
- `SaleID` (optional): Only return Finished Goods related to particular Sale

Response 200:

{

  "Page": 1,

### POST method Statuses meanings
| Status |Action |
|:-------|----------|
|`DRAFT`|Only new Finished Goods task will be created.|
|`AUTHORISED`|New Finished Goods task will be created and system will try to automatically add order items.|
|`IN PROGRESS`|New Finished Goods task will be created, system will try to automatically add order items and Pick items.|
|`COMPLETED`|New Finished Goods task will be created, system will try to automatically add order items, Pick items and Complete the task.|

## Finished Goods Pick

Path: `/finishedGoods/pick`

### Available fields for Finished Goods Pick
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |          |  Unique ID.        |
| `Status`  | String           |         |          |Finished Goods Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`IN PROGRESS`,`COMPLETED`,`VOIDED`. Available values for `POST` are `AUTHORISED`, `IN PROGRESS` and `COMPLETED`.|
| `WIPAccount`  | String           |         |          |Work in Progress Account. Read-only if current `Status` is not `AUTHORISED`|
| `WIPDate`  | DateTime           |         |          |Work in Progress Date. If `Status` is `COMPLETED` but task's `WIPDate` is empty, current date will be set. Read-only if current `Status` is not `AUTHORISED`|
| `Account`  | String           |         |          |Finished Goods Account. Read-only if current `Status` is not `AUTHORISED` or `IN PROGRESS`|
| `CompletionDate`  | DateTime           |         |   Yes       |Completion Date. If `Status` is `COMPLETED` but task's `CompletionDate` is empty, current date will be set. Read-only if current `Status` is not `AUTHORISED` or `IN PROGRESS`|
| `PickLines`  |<a href="#FinishedGoodsPickLineModel"><b>[] Finished Goods Pick Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
